Subject: SOC 2 Type II and renewal timing

Hi Jordan,

We’re finalizing vendor approvals for our Q3 renewal window and have two quick asks to complete procurement:

1) Can you provide the latest SOC 2 Type II report and a short summary of coverage (audit period dates)?
2) If the full Type II is not yet available for the period we need, will Redwood provide a bridge letter/interim attestation that covers the renewal cutoff (we need coverage through 2025-09-30)?

Our procurement deadline to present to the approvals committee is 2025-06-18, so if we can get the documents this week it would be ideal. Feel free to include a redlined SOW or any notes on contract start/end if that helps.

Thanks —
Emily Carter
Head of Procurement

Hi Emily/Jordan — looping in procurement/contract details.

Emily, to make sure your approvals committee has everything, please confirm that the packet below will suffice. If you need additional items call them out and we’ll prioritize:

Required for procurement packet (recommended):
- Full SOC 2 Type II report (PDF) — we’ll provide the latest (audit period: 2024-10-01 to 2025-03-31) and a one-page summary of scope.
- Bridge letter / interim attestation (DOCX) — draft attached; will explicitly state controls coverage through 2025-09-30 and call out any exceptions.
- Signed SOW or renewal addendum (PDF) — we’ve attached a redline of the SOW (Acme_SOW_v2.pdf). If you prefer an addendum instead of a full SOW replace, we can prepare that this week.
- Controls evidence index (CSV/one-pager) — mapping of SOC control sections to available artifacts (logs, policies, vendor attestations). We can share a sanitized index for procurement.

Timing: we can deliver the SOC II PDF and the bridge-letter draft by EOD Mon 6/9. Finalized signed documents (SOW/addendum) will require a brief review cycle (24-48 hours) once your procurement team confirms wording.

Notes on scope: the Type II report covers our hosted API and Redwood Dedicated control domain; it does not include client-managed on-prem deployments. If Acme uses a private deployment, please indicate and we’ll provide a narrow attestation.

Attachments: bridge-letter-draft.docx (draft), Acme_SOW_v2.pdf (redline), Redwood_TypeII_Summary_2024.pdf (one-page).

Best,
Laura Bennett
Sr. Contracts Manager | Redwood Inference

We confirm the 2024 Type II report audit period is 2024-10-01 to 2025-03-31 and the control families you listed are covered in the SOC scope. The draft bridge letter (attached) is acceptable and we have authority to sign an interim attestation that extends coverage language to 2025-09-30 for the purposes of procurement review.
